description: Creates ONE voice sound (a character line) in a game, in its Voices folder ("Vozes" in Portuguese games), created with the first line. Free: nothing is generated yet. name = what the game calls it (e.g. "Victory line", "Groovy"); text = exactly what the character says, as written (up to maxChars of list_voices; split longer speeches into several lines). Pick the voice, register and emotion from list_voices; language defaults to the game's. Returns the sound page (url) and the cost per version; then ask the user and generate it with generate_voice.

game_id.description: The game id, from list_games or create_game.

language.description: Language of the line. Omitted: the game's language.

name.description: The sound name the game calls (e.g. "Victory line").

register.description: coloquial (loose, the default), conversa (conversational) or formal (read). A voice without the register speaks formal.

text.description: The exact line the character says.

voice_id.description: A voice id from list_voices. Omitted: the first voice of the library.

name: create_voice
title: New voice line
